lines.speaker: VO
lines.text: Saturday. Everyone was home all day, and I had one job. Make the scariest ghost in history.

lines.speaker: SKYE
lines.text: Step one, eye holes. Step two, glow sticks. Step three, revenge.

lines.speaker: LILY
lines.text: That's Dad's good sheet.

lines.speaker: SKYE
lines.text: Ghosts don't use bad sheets.

lines.speaker: DAD
lines.text: Has anyone seen my good sheet?

lines.speaker: LILY
lines.text: No, Dad!

lines.speaker: SKYE
lines.text: I need more glow sticks. Where does Max keep his old stuff?

lines.speaker: LILY
lines.text: In that box. But nobody's allowed to touch it.

lines.speaker: SKYE
lines.text: What is this?

lines.speaker: SKYE
lines.text: Me and Skye. Best friends. He spelled friends wrong.

lines.speaker: LILY
lines.text: He drew it in kindergarten. He keeps it on top.

lines.speaker: SKYE
lines.text: He kept it. All this time.

lines.speaker: LILY
lines.text: He looks at it when he's sad.

lines.speaker: SKYE
lines.text: We were best friends. Then he knocked down my sandcastle, so I knocked down his. And we just never stopped.

lines.speaker: LILY
lines.text: For seven years?

lines.speaker: SKYE
lines.text: It was a really good sandcastle.

lines.speaker: LILY
lines.text: So are you still going to scare him?

lines.speaker: SKYE
lines.text: Yes.

lines.speaker: LILY
lines.text: You're both so dumb.

lines.speaker: DAD
lines.text: Lily? Why are there pancake crumbs on the attic ladder?

lines.speaker: LILY
lines.text: Ghost!

actions.text: Hard cut: the attic on Saturday afternoon. Skye cuts eye holes in a white bedsheet. Glow sticks on the floor. Lily watches with her teddy.
Skye opens the box marked MAX - OLD STUFF. On top: a crayon drawing of two stick kids holding hands, one with pink hair, and the words ME AND SKYE. BEST FRENDS.
Skye looks at the drawing for a long moment, puts it back gently on top, and picks up the sheet.
